Place these two third-party browser libraries in this folder:

1. html5-qrcode.min.js
   Project: html5-qrcode
   Used for live camera barcode and QR scanning.

2. qrcode.min.js
   Project: qrcode.js
   Used for browser-side QR label generation.

The package does not include third-party library source files.
Download maintained production builds and save them with the exact filenames above.
